positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "I do not support extreme measures to ban abortion. While I respect the moral convictions of all Nebraskans, I believe in limited government and I do not believe the government is capable of resolving this issue. Under extreme bans, abortion will still happen. We need to focus on the root cause: on reducing unwanted pregnancies."

positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "We can cut middle-class and small business tax rates, without increasing the deficit, by cutting wasteful spending and closing loopholes used by multi-nationals to avoid paying taxes. In particular: we can restrict the use of foreign tax havens to hide multinational corporate profits. Multi-national firms use these loopholes to pay little or no taxes, making it difficult for small businesses to compete."

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "Taxpayers have sent Moderna $10 billion in COVID subsidies. The CEO of Moderna made $398 million in 2022. Moderna just more than quadrupled the price of the COVID vaccine. This is madness. Stop handing huge subsidies to super-profitable pharmaceutical companies. In the heat of the pandemic, Congress handed over tens of billions of dollars to Big Pharma. Some of this turned into the vaccine. Much of it turned into CEO pay. As Senator, I will never support handing huge pharmaceuticals a blank check."
